name: Tier choice by passing work per cost
purpose: The chosen model for each tier passes the most work per dollar among the arms on the same cases.
record: Per tier: cases passed, tokens and price for each provider and model, and which arm the selector picks.
disadvantages: A changed price or work the cases do not cover moves the ranking unseen; the check is mechanics on authored cases.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the registry and tier-selection tests pass] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=the tier default is being challenged and the spend is approved]

name: Tier passing work per cost
purpose: The selector picks the arm with the most passing work per dollar, with every arm on the same cases.
record: Per tier: passing cases, tokens and the price on file for each arm.
disadvantages: A price that changed since its checked date moves the ranking unseen.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_tiers.py passes] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > measured [real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=the held arm and the candidate are both measured on the shared cases and every price row has a current checked_on]

name: Model quality on hard maths
purpose: How well each current model does exact-answer AIME 2025 problems under one prompt, so the tier selector chooses on measured passing work per cost.
record: Cases passed over the 30 AIME 2025 I and II problems; tokens priced from tier_prices.csv or counted in calls on a subscription.
disadvantages: 30 problems and one run per model leave wide intervals; the problem text is fetched from a pinned mirror, not committed.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the scorer passes the reference answer of every case and fails the no-answer floor; no model, no cost] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a model answers one problem end to end and is hand-read] > sample [sample=sample:3 | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=the one passed] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the three passed and the spend is approved]

name: Vendor arms answer
purpose: Each vendor at its cheapest current model answers exact-answer maths word problems, as evidence for which vendor serves a tier (vendors are complementary and are not ranked as rivals).
record: Cases passed over a fixed sample of 50 GSM8K test problems, with tokens priced at the cheapest model of each vendor and the cost counted in the score.
disadvantages: Vendor arms are not ranked: 50 problems and one prompt leave wide intervals.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the scorer passes the reference answer of every case and fails the no-answer floor; no model, no cost] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a vendor key or subscription is available: one problem answers end to end and is hand-read] > sample [sample=sample:10 | real=yes | min-pass-rate=0.8 | when=the one passed] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the ten passed and the spend is approved; the vendors are evidence for the tier choice and are not ranked]
command: esoi run call_a_model --impl gemini; esoi run call_a_model --impl openai; esoi run call_a_model --impl deepseek; esoi run call_a_model --impl claude_cli

name: Provider failover
purpose: A call is still answered when the primary provider fails, and a failure that is not the provider's (a bad request, a bad key) is raised, not hidden.
record: Cases passed over 30 recorded provider failures (billing, quota, timeout, outage, none) against fake providers: no model, no network, no key.
disadvantages: Fake providers use the vendors' published error wordings; a vendor that changes its wording is not seen until the cases are updated.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=fake providers raise each recorded failure; free, so the whole set always runs]

name: Model asked at the tier, within the budget
purpose: A question asked at a tier is answered by the model that tier names, and the goal record's model calls are spent one per question.
record: Thirty written tier cases against a recording provider (evaluation/model_call) and the budget cases of tests/test_models_via_provider.py.
disadvantages: Checks the call, not that the answer is any good.

name: Days since each seat was researched
purpose: Days since each seat was last researched and compared.
record: Days since each seat was last researched and compared. Draft: no cases or runs exist yet.
disadvantages: Days since research says a seat was looked at, not that its recommendation is still the best one.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_status.py and tests/test_registry.py pass on a fake registry]

name: Registry freshness reading
purpose: Each area's research age is read correctly and areas older than 90 days are named stale.
record: Cases passed over a fixed set of registry dates, including edge dates.
disadvantages: Reads the recorded date, not whether the recommendation is still the best.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_status.py and tests/test_registry.py pass on a fake registry]

name: Public stage sourced and triangulated
purpose: A public evaluation stage is used only when its source is named and at least two independent public results agree with it.
record: The share of public stages with a named source and a second independent confirming result.

name: Best in circumstance with variants
purpose: The winner of a seat is recorded per circumstance, with variants of a part compared on the same cases.
record: Winners recorded per circumstance, and variants run beside their base on the same cases.

name: Harness, context, sub-agents and recursion ranked
purpose: Harnesses are ranked by cost and time at the same pass rate, across the context given to them and their use of sub-agents and recursion.
record: A balanced score of pass rate, cost and time for each setting, on the same cases.

name: Search finds the source
purpose: A top-five search hit comes from a page or site that holds the answer to a factual question.
record: Cases passed over SimpleQA questions against their named source pages.

purpose: The best integration of each category is chosen by measurement.
record: The best integration of each category is chosen by measurement. Draft: no cases or runs exist yet.

name: Goal met by its own tests
purpose: A coding goal counts as done only when its own written tests pass after the arm has run, with the tests restored by the harness.
record: Cases passed over small coding goals, with calls, tokens and cost. The authoritative score is the balanced score of [balance.file_edit_goals] in esoi.toml (pass rate with cost per case and seconds per case, stated weights and budgets);
disadvantages: Does not see unrequested changes to other files, and public problems may be known to the model.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=competitive | when=changes made against a throwaway workspace by a fake model] > public [real=no | when=graded public evidence for the arms exists at grade C or better] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample did not decide]

name: Share of connections that need no code
purpose: A fake integration added through a hub connection alone is counted as needing zero code, and hand-wired services are counted as hand-wired.
record: Scores, per area, whether a hub is registered and connected by configuration, given a consumer's binding. A metric of Tools and of Hands (formerly the Connection Scorer solution). Cases passed over written bindings and registry facts.
disadvantages: A fake hub proves the configuration path, not that every real integration fits it.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_registry.py passes with a fake hub accepted by configuration]

record: Draft: no cases or runs exist yet.

name: Files read inside the folder
purpose: Files of a folder are listed and read, a path outside the folder is refused, and what is not text or too large is skipped.
record: Conformance cases written here over a temporary folder.
disadvantages: Local files only; a remote file system is a researched candidate with no arm yet.
